acceptanceCriteria: Automated host tests demonstrate that the iPhone and Watch renderer paths remain silent until explicit Play and stop on selection, interruption, route loss, or engine failure.
Click-free ramps, selected-frequency integrity, bounded output, and lifecycle/UI truthfulness have deterministic evidence for both platform hosts.
The evidence package distinguishes automated checks, simulator inspection, and physical-device listening, route, latency, endurance, energy, thermal, and accessibility observations.
notes: Planning complete. This Task qualifies the host integration delivered by T-0027 and T-0028; it does not replace EP-008 release qualification or authorize submission.
Observed approved-requirement violations become Issues. A simulator build, deterministic buffer test, or listening assertion from an agent is not physical-device acceptance.
Activated with SP-019 by user on 2026-09-20.
rationale: The product cannot claim actual reference-tone playback until the new platform hosts have deterministic integration coverage and separately recorded hardware evidence.
testSteps: Run the T-0027 and T-0028 deterministic host suites plus JT-TEST-024, JT-TEST-025, JT-TEST-032, JT-TEST-038, JT-TEST-040, JT-TEST-115, JT-TEST-116, JT-TEST-131, JT-TEST-134 through JT-136, JT-TEST-140 through JT-143, and JT-TEST-144 through JT-146 where applicable.

Separate automated renderer and host results from simulator UI inspection and physical-device evidence. Record build or commit, platform, model, OS, route, starting state, selected tone, level, exact actions, expected result, observed result, and evidence source.

Retain residual device obligations for listening quality, routes, interruptions, latency, endurance, energy, thermal state, Low Power Mode, and accessibility; user review remains required for acceptance.
